welcome.title: Welcome to TideMind
welcome.subtitle: A living second brain that connects everything you think with — your AI agents, your notes, and whatever comes next.

preferences.title: Personalize Your Experience
preferences.description: Choose your preferred language and theme.

model.title: Connect a Language Model
model.description: TideMind needs an LLM to understand, connect, and evolve your memories. Configure at least one model connection to enable full functionality.
model.skipWarning: Without a model connection, core features like memory digestion and association discovery will be unavailable. You can configure this later in Settings.

agent.title: Connect Your Dev Tools
agent.description: Link your development tools (like Claude Code or Cursor) so TideMind becomes your memory companion while coding.

noteSource.title: Import Your Notes
noteSource.description: If you use Logseq, Obsidian, or Apple Notes, you can import your existing notes into TideMind's knowledge graph.

cloudSync.title: Connect to TideMind Cloud
cloudSync.description: Optionally sync your brain to the cloud for multi-device access and more integrations.
cloudSync.info: Cloud sync is optional. Your local brain works perfectly on its own. You can connect to the cloud anytime in Settings.

complete.title: You're All Set
complete.subtitle: Here's a summary of your setup:
